title: pledge.toml configuration (after TOML decoding)
$comment: Filesystem existence, directory/file types, and containment after symlink resolution require runtime validation.

roots.description: Repository-relative source directories, not globs. A dot selects the repository root.

namespace.description: ASCII dotted Python package prefix used for internal imports.

contract.description: Repository-relative architecture contract file, independent of scan roots.

relativePath.description: POSIX repository-relative path; no absolute path, backslash, NUL, or parent component.
